input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties or early-termination charge on us. Termination (§14) is by written notice with services simply continuing to the end of the following month, with no minimum-term buyout or termination fee. Compensation (§5) is limited to ordinary monthly fees for Hosting and Support Services actually requested (subject to a monthly minimum, which is a pricing floor rather than a liquidated damages amount), and the anti-spam covenant (§7) carries no per-message penalty or stipulated damages. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "damages" and "shall pay" return no Customer-payable stipulated amounts. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is proposed. We note only that the monthly minimums in §5(a)/§6 are blank and are excluded from the documentation/dispute rights — a commercial point for the pricing rule, not an LD issue.
